method: Read existing boundary full-frame/head-window boards and three native midpoint PNGs with view_image. No video or receipt edits and no new source scan.
summary: No sampled defect blocks handing this research preview to the user for normal-speed comfort review. All three new joins visibly superimpose faces, limbs and rigid background lines. J34 has the strongest face/head displacement; J45 has the clearest face-angle/expression change; J23 has conspicuous gait-phase double legs. Broad person scale is comparable, but exact match is absent. Ghosting clears in the displayed pure-source frames after the overlap.
limitations: Still-frame boundary review cannot establish perceived comfort, blink/flash response or whole-film rhythm at normal speed.
No claim of zero identity drift, exact garment geometry, seamless one-take continuity or user motion approval.
Previously accepted residual still texture and existing source QA remain unchanged.
The intended cross-dissolve is visible and is not being treated as proof that all sources are geometrically identical.

joins.viewed_boundary_context: All 18 overlap frames plus eight frames on each side, as displayed in the existing QA boards; one native midpoint frame inspected separately.

observations.severity: visible moderate-to-strong dissolve ghosting; not a seamless match
observations.body_and_scale: Head-to-shoe framing stays broadly comparable; there is no abrupt extreme zoom. Gait phases differ, causing separated feet, doubled lower legs and a widened transient body outline. Torso/arm positions differ.
observations.face_expression: Double eyes, nose and mouth are visible near the middle of the overlap. The incoming head position and smaller smile differ mildly; clear frames on either side remain readable.
observations.background: Window mullions and stone joints occupy different positions; overlapping structures form parallel/diagonal double lines. The outgoing windowed view becomes the incoming plainer wall view.
observations.most_visible_region: Lower legs/feet and the face near output f281–287 (about11.71–11.96s).

joins.viewed_boundary_context: All 18 overlap frames plus eight frames on each side, as displayed in the existing QA boards; one native midpoint frame inspected separately.

observations.severity: strongest face/head misalignment of the three inspected new joins
observations.body_and_scale: Broad full-person scale is similar, but the incoming torso/head is displaced and leg phases differ. Black skirt and charcoal trousers overlap as two separate silhouettes; arms and shoes double conspicuously.
observations.face_expression: Horizontal plus slight vertical head offset produces visibly separated eyes and two facial profiles around the center of the dissolve. This is overlap of distinct frames; it must not be described as zero-difference or identity-perfect changing clothes.
observations.background: Large wall/window/pillar lines do not match; a windowed outgoing view and different incoming masonry/window position form conspicuous doubled rigid lines.
observations.most_visible_region: Face/shoulder double contours and skirt/trouser silhouette near f419–425 (about17.46–17.71s).

joins.viewed_boundary_context: All 18 overlap frames plus eight frames on each side, as displayed in the existing QA boards; one native midpoint frame inspected separately.

observations.severity: visible moderate-to-strong ghosting, particularly expression/angle change and legs
observations.body_and_scale: The white shirt gives a common torso cue, but side-on skirt walking changes to a more frontal trousers view; shoulder width and gait phase therefore differ even at broadly similar full-person scale. Two pairs of shoe/leg silhouettes coexist during the dissolve.
observations.face_expression: Outgoing neutral more side-on gaze changes to a more frontal, slightly smiling incoming face. Double eyes/mouth are visible mid-overlap. This expression/angle change is more conspicuous than a simple color swap.
observations.background: Outgoing steps/door-side masonry fade into the incoming plainer wall. Wall joints/vertical edges form double lines during overlap.
observations.most_visible_region: Face expression/angle and blue-to-black shoulder bag change around f557–563 (about23.21–23.46s).
